_comment: LBNL FDD Fan-Power Unit (FPU; parallel PFPU / series SFPU) point -> CAMBER Role mapping. Faults are imposed in the WEST zone (column suffix _W), so the _W VAV-box columns are the device under test (the _I/_S/_E zones stay healthy). The reheat ΔT for the reheat-valve detector is VAV_DAT_W (leaving, warm) minus the AHU supply SA_TEMP (entering the box, cool). Dataset: LBNL Fault Detection and Diagnostics Datasets (CC-BY). Validates the VAV zone-terminal drift family (airflow/damper and reheat-valve) on real (simulated) labeled faults.
